description:
Problem. TPC-DS Q16 and Q95 carried branches comparing `ctx.platform` with `"datafusion"` while the adapter reports `"DataFusion"`; they were dead from v0.1.1 until removed in PR #4169, and nothing failed. The same mistake can be written again: `ctx.platform` is the adapter's display name (`Polars`, `DataFusion`, `PySpark`, `LakeSail`, `Dask`, `Pandas`, `cuDF`), and code asks which engine it is on in different ways: exact display name (`benchbox/core/tpcds/dataframe_queries/queries.py`, `_sql_rank_expression`, `!= "Polars"`), lower-cased with separator normalisation (`benchbox/core/read_primitives/dataframe_queries.py`, `_is_dask_context`, `_is_datafusion_context`), set membership on `self._adapter.platform_name` (`benchbox/platforms/dataframe/expression_family.py`), and string checks inside `unified_frame.py`.

Expected: one typed way to ask which engine a context runs on (an enum plus a lookup or predicate reachable from the context), used by the query modules, so a misspelt or wrong-case name raises or fails type checking instead of comparing false.

Decision gate (member, before editing): choose where the typed identity lives so that `benchbox/core` does not import adapter SDKs and the `DataFrameContext` protocol stays satisfied by both families. Record the choice in the landing report. Convert the query-module sites (TPC-DS, read primitives) and `expression_family.py`; convert `unified_frame.py` internals only if it is a mechanical change with no behaviour difference, otherwise leave them and say so.

Frozen scope: `benchbox/core/dataframe/context.py`, `benchbox/core/dataframe/__init__.py`, `benchbox/core/dataframe/engine.py`, `benchbox/core/read_primitives/dataframe_queries.py`, `benchbox/core/tpcds/dataframe_queries/queries.py`, `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/expression_family.py`, `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/pandas_family.py`, `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/unified_frame.py`, `tests/unit/core/dataframe/test_engine_identity*`, `tests/unit/core/read_primitives/*`, `tests/unit/core/tpcds/*`.

Guardrails (members of batch df-platform-followups):
- Stay inside the frozen scope below; a path outside it is refused at landing. If the work needs another path, stop and report it.
- No explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001). Search for an existing helper before adding one (`make duplicate-check-delta`).
- Do not edit SQL text, reference answers, expected-result fixtures or baselines to make a check pass.
- Members make no tracker write, open no PR, do not run the fast tier, benchmarks or timing runs, and never force heavy-work admission. They use absolute paths under their own worktree and stop at a landing report.
- One `changelog.d/` fragment per member.
- `ctx.platform` keeps returning the same display string; results, logs and published bundles read it.
- No query pattern may be selected by platform for speed. The existing three behaviours (Polars NULL rank handling, Dask and DataFusion read-primitive paths) must not change.
- Do not edit `benchbox/platforms/dataframe/*_df.py`, `benchmark_mixin.py` or `benchbox/core/dataframe/capabilities.py`; other members own them.
